title: G6: Subterm criterion for relative DP problems

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
Adapt the Hirokawa–Middeldorp subterm criterion.

**Conjectured statement.** Let $\pi$ be a simple projection ($\pi(f^\#)\in\{1,\dots,\mathrm{ar}(f)\}$). If for every pair $\ell^\#\to t^\#\in\mathcal P$ we have $\pi(\ell^\#)\trianglerighteq\pi(t^\#)$, and additionally the $\to_S$-connections are non-increasing under $\pi$ (to be formalized), then pairs with $\pi(\ell^\#)\rhd\pi(t^\#)$ can be removed.

**Must prove / clarify:**
- Exact compatibility condition between $\pi$ and $\to_S$: in the classical proof $t^\#\sigma\to_R^*s^\#\sigma$ does not increase the projected term because $\rhd$ is closed under the relation used. With $\to_S$ in the connection, one must require $\pi$-compatibility of $S$ (e.g. $\pi$ projects $S$-steps to $\to_S^*$ or to equalities); state and justify the precise condition.
- Prove that an infinite chain with all pairs $\trianglerighteq$ under $\pi$ and infinitely many $\rhd$ yields an infinite $\rhd$-descent — contradiction with well-foundedness of the strict subterm relation.
